dependency_semantics: success means valid identity/numerics/completeness; a valid scientific negative exits successfully
scheduler_mapping: afterok of all declared upstream stages; no job IDs allocated in this design

nodes.action: Bind verified source, dataset, checkpoint payloads, full W0 and token manifest

Package five figures, tables, raw manifests, missingness and claim limits

retries: Technical retry only after cause is recorded; immutable completed receipts; no silent result replacement
